identity.summary: UFC lists the Polish light heavyweight's bio: two-time Polish Kyokushinkai champion (2010, 2012) and second at the 2012 European Championship.

national.note: The almanac lists him second at +90 kg (misspelled 'Marchin Prachino', Poland) at the 2012 IKO-1 European Weight Category Championships in Budapest, behind Djema Belkhodja (France), and third at -90 kg at the 2011 IKO-1 Europeans in Padova. A video of the Belkhodja vs Prachnio +90 final and his UFC bio agree. Not recorded as a claim because the almanac is not a federation source. The Antwerp (EKO) and Kielce (WKO) Europeans of 2012 are different organisations and don't list him. To resolve, find the IKO (kyokushinkaikan.org) or Hungarian organiser's 2012 Budapest results.
